headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 6, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets secured a thrilling 10-9 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Drake Baldwin leading the offense. The Pittsburgh Pirates cruised past the Washington Nationals 11-5, with Brandon Lowe hitting a home run and driving in three runs. The Minnesota Twins took down the New York Yankees 6-1, with Joe Ryan pitching 7.0 innings of shutout baseball.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Atlanta Braves left-handed pitcher Martín Pérez, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left forearm contusion. Other notable injuries include Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Brandon Woodruff, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation, and Colorado Rockies right-handed pitcher Tomoyuki Sugano, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 1, 2026, with back spasms.

The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return. The Minnesota Twins have also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Woo-Suk Go from the Detroit Tigers for cash.

top_news.title: **Mets Edge Braves in Thrilling 10-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets outlasted the Atlanta Braves in a back-and-forth contest, ultimately securing a 10-9 win. Drake Baldwin led the Mets' offense with a strong performance, going 2-for-4 with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Nationals 11-5**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 11-5 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Brandon Lowe leading the offense. Lowe hit a home run and drove in three runs, while Eddy Yean pitched a strong 2.0 innings in relief.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 3-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Nick Lodolo earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. Spencer Steer led the Reds' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Yankees 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 6-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Joe Ryan pitching 7.0 innings of shutout baseball, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 3 hits. Royce Lewis led the Twins' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Braves Place Martín Pérez on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Atlanta Braves left-handed pitcher Martín Pérez has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left forearm contusion.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return.
